rules.name: Automated Uplink Relay faction objective
rules.description:
This is a large personal automated objective marker placed after deployment zones are chosen, but before forces are deployed. It must be initially placed entirely within your deployment zone. The opposing player may then shift its location up to 6”, though you choose its final facing. It can generate a maximum of 3 VPs per game, after which it shuts down and is removed.

Partial: (each end phase) If the relay is not destroyed/shut down & also the Contact Headquarters ability was not utilized that turn, gain 1 VP.

Full: (end of game) If the relay is not destroyed, gain all of its remaining VPs.

Contact Headquarters: In the command phase, if the relay hasn’t been destroyed/shut down, you may generate +1 command point.

Automated Objective: Although a unit, it does not count as one towards any other mission objectives. It cannot be put into reserve or be a reinforcement. The only voluntary main action it can perform is Advance & Fire.

rules.name: Master of Machines Faction Objective
rules.description:
This objective may only be utilized if your force contains a Master Bot Handler. If utilized, a Master Bot Handler is automatically your force commander for any objective type that requires one. 

This objective type can generate a maximum of 3 VPs per game, after which you may no longer utilize the Bot Mastery ability. 

---------------------------------------------------

Partial: (each end phase) If at least one of your Master Bot Handlers is on the table and the Bot Mastery ability was not utilized that turn, gain 1 VP.

Full: (end of game) If at least one of your Master Bot Handlers is still on the table, gain all of this objective's remaining VPs.

Bot Mastery: Once per turn, you may automatically enable one of your unit's bot protocols when that unit is activated (regardless of whether its activiation discipline check is successfully passed). You must have at least one Master Bot Handler on the table to utilize this ability.

sharedRules.name: Bot Handler
sharedRules.description: All robots in the unit have the Bodyguard (4+) ability. When a bot handler issues an order to a unit with Bot Protocols, and that unit passes its activation discipline check, their Bot Protocols are enabled. A bot handler can issue an order to a unit with no STs.

sharedRules.name: Aerial Uplink Micro-drone
sharedRules.description: The Aerial Drone Strike’s Limited Use ability improves to (2) instead of (1).

sharedRules.name: Command Booster Micro-drone
sharedRules.description: The bot handler’s command range is increased to 24”. If taken by a model with the Command (0) ability, it instead removes the restriction that the model may only issue an order to its own unit.

sharedRules.name: Micro Defense Drones
sharedRules.description: Can be activated at any point during a turn, but only once per game. When activated, the model gains the Field (2) ability and use of the Micro Defense Drones weapon profile for the remainder of the turn.

sharedRules.name: Spotter Micro-drone
sharedRules.description: The bot handler gains the Paint (4+) ability on all of its attacks, not including CQ attacks and those that have either the Ind Fire or Smart ability.

sharedRules.name: Targeting Micro-drone
sharedRules.description: The model, and any unit it is joined to gains the Marksman (+3) ability, which does benefit an Aerial Drone Strike fired by that unit.

sharedRules.name: Bot Repairs (D3)
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) When this unit completes an Advance & Fire or Dash action, as long as it isn't on the move or pinned, it may select one friendly Foundation unit within 6" that contains at least half robot models and isn't on the move itself. The selected unit immediately removes D3 STs. This ability cannot be used into or out of a building.

sharedRules.name: Bot Protocol - Stay Low!
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) While enabled, the unit's Dug-in ability is improved by +1. If the unit doesn't have the Dug-in ability, it instead gains the Dug-in (+1) ability.

sharedRules.name: Marksman (+3)
sharedRules.description: Add 3 to the model's SKL when shooting, except in CQ fighting.

sharedRules.name: Advanced Tracking
sharedRules.description: Long ranged weapons fired by this model at short range do not automatically miss.

sharedRules.name: Bot Protocol - Rapid Fire
sharedRules.description: When enabled, during the unit’s main action, the model gains +1 SHO for a single weapon that it fires.

sharedRules.name: Point Defense Action
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) Once per turn, when another visible friendly Foundation unit within 6” declares it is making a Defensive Fire action, this unit may choose to make a Point Defense action against the same target. This is a free action resolved like a standard Defensive Fire action before the friendly unit takes its defensive fire discipline check, except that the target automatically counts as being at standard range (instead of short range) and short ranged weapons cannot be used.

sharedRules.name: Bot Protocol - Overdrive
sharedRules.description: While enabled, increase the model’s MV value by +1 for every command point expended this turn issuing an order to that unit by a model with the Bot Handler ability, up to a maximum of +5.

sharedRules.name: Chemtek Sprayer
sharedRules.description: Enemy units containing at least one organic model treat the area within 6” of a model with a Chemtek Sprayer as lethal ground.

sharedRules.name: Linebreaker
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) When an enemy unit takes a CQ discipline check following a round of CQ fighting against a unit with this ability, the result needed to pass is increased by one, so if the check would normally pass on a roll of 3+, it instead requires a roll of 4+.

sharedRules.name: Slaved (designator)
sharedRules.description: If a unit ever contains only slaved models, remove those models as casualties. This occurs only after the action that removed the last non-slaved model from the unit and any free actions triggered by that same action have been fully resolved.

sharedRules.name: Bot Protocol - Defensive Maneuvers
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) While enabled, the unit gains the Dodge (1) ability, or adds +1 to its existing Dodge ability.

sharedRules.name: Bot Protocol - Lock-on
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) When enabled, if the unit performs an Advance & Fire main action, instead of the standard round of shooting normally allowed, it may make either a special focused fire or suppressive fire round of shooting.

sharedRules.name: Fire Assist (+1)
sharedRules.description: A model with this ability is able to fire 1 more weapon during each round of shooting than they are normally allowed. Note that when a model is not allowed to fire at all, this ability does not allow them to.

sharedRules.name: Neural Node
sharedRules.description: Each turn, as long as a command model does not fire as part of its main action, each Neural Node it is equipped with allows the model to issue an order to one more friendly unit than is normally allowed. Note that when a command model isn’t allowed to issue any orders at all, a Neural Node does not allow them to.

sharedRules.name: Bot Protocol - Swarm Defense
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) While enabled, this unit has the Dodge (X) ability, with X equal to the current number of models in the unit with this bot protocol. When one or more hits are ignored by this Dodge during a round of shooting, immediately roll a D6. If the result is equal to or less than the number of hits that were ignored, then a single model in the unit with this bot protocol suffers an automatic injury.

sharedRules.name: Bot Repairs (2D3)
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) When this unit completes an Advance & Fire or Dash action, as long as it isn't on the move or pinned, it may select one friendly Foundation unit within 6" that contains at least half robot models and isn't on the move itself. The selected unit immediately removes 2D3 STs. This ability cannot be used into or out of a building.

sharedRules.name: Cover Drill
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) While performing an Advance & Fire main action, this unit may elect to be pinned after it completes its move but before it shoots.

sharedRules.name: Shock Assault
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) This unit has the Dodge (2) ability while targeted by enemy defensive fire.

sharedRules.name: SecDef Commander
sharedRules.description: For each command point expended issuing an order to a SecDef unit, that unit removes 2 STs instead of 1. This character can only join a unit which has the SecDef designator. SecDef Tactical Teams may be taken as a [Core] selection in detachments led by this model.

sharedRules.name: Sit Rep
sharedRules.description: During either an Advance & Fire or Hold & Fire main action, if this model forgoes firing a weapon, generate 1 command point into your command point pool.

sharedRules.name: Target Designator
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) All of this unit's non-CQ attacks gain the Paint (6+) ability.

sharedRules.name: Enhanced Bot Repairs (+D3)
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) While a model with this ability is part of a unit, that unit's Bot Repairs ability is improved by (+D3).

sharedRules.name: Enhanced Medic (+D3)
sharedRules.description: (squad ability) While a model with this ability is part of a unit, that unit's Medic ability is improved by (+D3).
